text.hi: इस पाठ ‘Anita Feeds Appu’ में 7 नए शब्द हैं। हर शब्द सुनो, उसका मतलब समझो और बोलो।
text.hinglish: Is paath ‘Anita Feeds Appu’ mein 7 naye shabd hain. Har shabd suno, uska matlab samjho aur bolo.
text.en: This lesson, ‘Anita Feeds Appu’, has 7 new words. Listen to each word, learn its meaning and say it.

steps.example: Can you balance a book on your head?

exampleMeaning.hi: क्या तुम अपने सिर पर किताब संभाल सकते हो?
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Kya tum apne sir par kitaab sambhaal sakte ho?

steps.meaning: to feel certain that something is true
steps.example: I believe my friend because he never tells lies.

exampleMeaning.hi: मैं अपने दोस्त पर विश्वास करता/करती हूँ क्योंकि वह कभी झूठ नहीं बोलता।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Main apne dost par vishwaas karta/karti hoon kyonki woh kabhi jhooth nahi bolta.

steps.meaning: a funny drawing in a newspaper, a magazine or on T.V.

exampleMeaning.hi: मेरे छोटे भाई को कार्टून बहुत पसंद हैं।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Mere chhote bhai ko cartoon bahut pasand hain.

steps.meaning: an open space with buildings around it
steps.example: Grandmother dries chillies in the courtyard.

exampleMeaning.hi: दादी आँगन में मिर्च सुखाती हैं।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Daadi aangan mein mirch sukhaati hain.

steps.meaning: very happy and eager about something
steps.example: We are excited about the school picnic.

exampleMeaning.hi: हम स्कूल की पिकनिक को लेकर बहुत उत्साहित हैं।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Hum school ki picnic ko lekar bahut utsaahit hain.

steps.example: The hungry goat gobbled up all the grass.

exampleMeaning.hi: भूखी बकरी सारी घास गपागप खा गई।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Bhookhi bakri saari ghaas gapagap kha gayi.

steps.meaning: feeling surprise because something was not expected
steps.example: I was surprised to see snow on the hills.

exampleMeaning.hi: पहाड़ों पर बर्फ़ देखकर मैं हैरान रह गया/गई।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Pahaadon par barf dekhkar main hairaan reh gaya/gayi.

text.hi: अब पाठ के 7 छोटे वाक्यांश (phrases) सीखते हैं, जैसे ‘at one go’ यानी ‘एक ही बार में’।
text.hinglish: Ab paath ke 7 chhote phrases seekhte hain, jaise ‘at one go’ yaani ‘ek hi baar mein’.
text.en: Now let's learn the lesson's 7 phrases, like ‘at one go’, which means all at once.

instruction.hi: हर phrase को उसके मतलब से जोड़ो
instruction.hinglish: Har phrase ko uske matlab se jodo
instruction.en: Join each phrase to its meaning

pairs.right: all at once, in one try
to make work easier for someone
to sit on an animal or a cycle and move
to look at something carefully for some time
